## Locan (CR 16)

**XP** 76,800  
LG Large magical beast  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +32  
**Aura** frightful presence (180 ft., DC 25)  


**Defense**


**AC** 33, touch 10, flat-footed 32 (+1 Dex, +23 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 294 (21d10+84)  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +13, **Will** +14  
**DR** 10/adamantine; **Immune** cold, fire, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 27  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., fly 250 ft. (average), swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +27 (2d6+10/19-20 plus grab), 2 claws +29 (2d6+7/19-20 plus grab)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, 14d10 fire, DC 26, usable every 1d4 rounds), pounce, rake (2 claws, 2d6+7)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 21st)  


At will—bristle, daylight, detect evil  



**Statistics**


**Str** 25, **Dex** 12, **Con** 19, **Int** 20, **Wis** 21, **Cha** 20  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +28; **CMD** 39 (43 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Alertness, Critical Focus, Extend Spell, Improved Critical (bite, claw), Improved Natural Weapon (claw), Iron Will, Stunning Critical, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +28, Fly +16, Heal +28, Knowledge (arcana, local, nobility, religion) +28, Perception +32, Sense Motive +40, Spellcraft +28, Swim +30; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Sense Motive  
**Languages** Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elven, Halfling  
**SQ** trainer spells (CL 10th)
